overview_description.description:
AllSome is a platform that connect modern online merchants to spare warehouse to store and send cross-border shipment in a painless way, specifically focused from China to South East Asia. AllSome provides services to procure, receive, quality check, store, and send packages directly to buyers'​ doorstep at an affordable and painless way.

The company was founded on 2017 and is based in ShenZhen, China.

about_short_description.short_description: AllSome is a parcel tracking system that provides e-commerce fulfillment and logistic solutions for online sellers.

product.name: AllSome Fulfilment
product.description: A cross-border e-commerce fulfillment management service that supports online merchants from overseas suppliers to global buyers.

product.name: Package Tracking
product.description: A system for tracking parcels throughout the fulfillment and delivery process for e-commerce sellers.

product.name: Supplier Management
product.description: A service to manage relationships and logistics with overseas suppliers for e-commerce merchants.

product.name: Cross Border End-to-End Notification
product.description: A notification system that provides updates throughout the entire cross-border fulfillment process.

product.name: Brand Identity System Integration
product.description: Integration of brand identity elements into the fulfillment and packaging process for e-commerce sellers.

product.name: Performance Report
product.description: A reporting service that provides data and analytics on fulfillment and logistics performance for e-commerce sellers.
